nativeAttachedStatus.message: $COUNT$ supported tab(s) attached to Native Blink

nativeWarning.message: Native mode uses Chrome's debugger API. Chrome may show a debugger warning, and managed devices can restrict debugger attachment.

jsFooter.message: JS mode registers the tested compatibility script only while JS mode is active. Native mode never injects that script.

nativeConfirm.message: Native mode attaches Chrome's debugger API to browser tabs. Chrome may show a debugger warning. Continue?

nativeDebuggerWarning.message: Native Blink uses Chrome's debugger API and requires the debugger permission. The browser can show a debugger warning while a tab is attached.

defaultStartupModeDesc.message: Mode restored when Chrome starts, according to the startup option below.

autoApplyNewTabsDesc.message: Applies the active mode to newly created supported tabs.

reloadModeChangeDesc.message: Recommended. Reloading is the only reliable way to remove an already injected JS spoof before switching modes.

restoreStartup.message: Restore the selected mode on startup

restoreStartupDesc.message: When disabled, the extension starts in Off mode after Chrome launches.

showBadgeDesc.message: Shows JS or N on the extension icon while a non-Off mode is active.

nativeSectionDesc.message: Uses chrome.debugger with Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled. This changes Blink's focus emulation path instead of replacing page JavaScript APIs.

nativeReapplyDesc.message: Re-sends the Blink focus emulation command after supported tab navigation or reload.

jsSectionDesc.message: Uses the tested page-level compatibility spoof. It is isolated from Native mode and is never registered while Native mode is active.

hostAccessNote.message: Host access is required for JS mode on supported web pages. Chrome internal pages, extension pages and DevTools are excluded by design.

confirmReset.message: Reset all settings and disable the spoof?

languageDesc.message: Popup and settings language. Other extension pages stay in English.

helpDefaultMode.message: This is the mode selected automatically when startup restoration is enabled.

helpNewTabs.message: In Native mode, new supported tabs are attached automatically. In JS mode, the registered content script applies automatically.

helpReload.message: Turning this off can leave a page with the previous mode until it is manually reloaded.

helpRestore.message: Controls whether the current mode survives a full Chrome restart.

helpBadge.message: The badge is only a visual indicator in the toolbar.

helpNativeReapply.message: Navigation can reset renderer state, so the extension can send the Native Blink command again after a completed navigation.

helpLanguage.message: Automatic follows Chrome's UI language. English and Russian can be selected explicitly.

benchmarkDesc.message: Run the built-in English benchmark to compare Normal, JS and Native behavior.

modeOffLine.message: Off → no injected script and no debugger attachment

settingsIntro.message: Configure how the extension starts and how mode changes are applied.

startupIntro.message: Configure how the extension starts and how mode changes are applied.

nativeWarningText.message: Native mode uses Chrome's debugger API and requires the debugger permission. Chrome can display a debugger warning, and managed devices can restrict debugger attachment.

autoNativeNewTabsDesc.message: In Native mode, automatically attach focus emulation to newly created supported tabs.
